title: Toys Per Kilo in the Philippines: A Practical Buyer Guide
description: Learn how Toyzoona Importer's toys-per-kilo buying model works, who it is best for, what to check before buying, and how to plan a better bulk toy haul.
summary: Toys per kilo is a bulk-buying format where buyers choose from available toy stocks and pay by weight. For Toyzoona buyers, it is useful for resale, giveaways, party prizes, family hauls, live selling inventory, and flexible toy sourcing when variety matters more than buying one exact model.
deck: A buyer-first guide to understanding Toyzoona Importer's per-kilo system, from choosing stock and setting a budget to checking live schedules and planning your next warehouse visit.

heroImage.alt: Wide Toyzoona toy stock display with colorful imported toys prepared for buyers
heroImage.caption: Toyzoona stock changes by batch, so the best buying plan starts with current availability.

takeaways: Paying by kilo is best when you need volume, variety, and flexible toy bundles.
UK preloved toys and China brand-new per-kilo stock serve different buyer needs.
Always check the official Facebook page before planning a visit.
Sort your haul by age, theme, and condition before reselling or gifting.

sections.heading: What toys per kilo actually means
body: In a toys-per-kilo setup, the buyer focuses on the available stock mix and the total weight of the haul rather than the retail price of each individual toy. This makes the buying experience closer to sourcing inventory than shopping from a normal toy shelf.

The format works especially well when you are open to variety. A single haul can include character toys, educational items, baby toys, pretend-play pieces, boxed goods, mixed bins, and surprise finds depending on the current batch.

For Toyzoona Importer, this model is positioned for buyers who want practical volume: resellers building inventory, families preparing gifts, event organizers creating prize packs, and live sellers who need fast-moving product variety.

image.alt: Mixed Toyzoona toy bins arranged for per-kilo buying
image.caption: Mixed bins are useful for buyers who want flexible bundles instead of one fixed toy type.

bullets: Best for buyers who want more toys per trip.
Useful when you can sort, clean, bundle, or resell items after buying.
Not ideal if you need one exact toy model or one guaranteed character line.
sections.quote: The real value of per-kilo buying is not just price - it is the amount of variety one haul can create.

sections.heading: Who should buy toys this way
body: Parents use per-kilo buying when they want a larger pool of toys for siblings, cousins, holiday gifting, or reward boxes. Resellers use it because mixed toy inventory can be turned into albums, bundles, live selling sets, or themed posts.

Event organizers can also benefit. School programs, birthday parties, raffles, Christmas activities, and classroom reward systems often need many toys at once. Buying by kilo gives organizers room to create small, medium, and standout prize tiers.

The key is to buy with a plan. A reseller should know the target customer before choosing stock. A parent should consider age suitability. An event buyer should think in terms of themes, safety, and how many children need prizes.

image.alt: Children and families near Toyzoona toy stocks during a toy buying event
image.caption: Bulk toys can support family buying, event prizes, and resale inventory when sorted properly.

bullets: For resellers: sort by category before pricing.
For parents: separate baby, preschool, and older-kid items.
For events: prepare bundles by age range and prize tier.

sections.heading: How to buy from Toyzoona Importer
body: The simplest buying path is to check the Toyzoona Laguna Facebook page, review current announcements, watch for live selling updates, and message the official page before visiting or ordering. Stock can move quickly, so current updates matter more than old screenshots.

The website countdown follows the regular Monday to Saturday buying window from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine time. Saturday auction announcements and special stock previews may also appear on the Facebook page.

If you plan to visit the warehouse, prepare a budget range, a list of toy categories you want, and enough time to inspect the available stocks. The strongest buyers are usually the ones who can decide quickly because they already know what their audience or event needs.

image.alt: Toyzoona showroom-style toy display for warehouse buyers
image.caption: Warehouse visits work best when buyers already know what type of haul they want.

sections.quote: Check the current batch first, then decide. In bulk toy buying, timing and availability drive the haul.

title: Toy Reseller Starter Guide: How to Turn Bulk Toys Into Sellable Inventory
description: A practical starter guide for toy resellers in the Philippines covering buyer targeting, sorting, pricing, photos, live selling, and content planning.
summary: A new toy reseller should prepare a target buyer, budget range, sorting workflow, photo setup, posting schedule, and basic pricing system before buying bulk toys. The money is not made only at the warehouse - it is made in how the haul is sorted, presented, bundled, and sold.
deck: Before buying your first bulk toy haul, build a simple resale system. This guide shows what to prepare so Toyzoona stocks can become organized, searchable, and sellable inventory.

heroImage.alt: Branded toy shelves with imported toys for Toyzoona bulk buyers and resellers
heroImage.caption: A reseller's advantage comes from turning mixed stock into clear buying choices.

takeaways: Choose a target buyer before choosing toys.
Sort inventory before posting anything for sale.
Use bundles, albums, short videos, and live selling to move stock faster.
Track cost, weight, condition, and selling price from the first haul.

sections.heading: Start with the customer, not the haul
body: New resellers often make the mistake of buying only what looks cute in the moment. A better approach is to define the buyer first. Are you selling to parents of toddlers, collectors, gift shoppers, teachers, party planners, or other resellers?

Your target buyer affects everything: the toys you choose, the way you sort them, the words you use in captions, the price range you offer, and the platform where you sell. Preschool toys, branded character items, educational toys, plush toys, and surprise bundles can all work, but they do not appeal to exactly the same audience.
When you know the customer, you can walk into a bulk buying session with focus. That prevents random overspending and helps you build inventory that fits your actual market.

image.alt: Character toys from Toyzoona stock for reseller sorting
image.caption: Character toys usually sell best when photographed clearly and grouped by familiar themes.

bullets: Parents want age-safe, useful, and recognizable toys.
Collectors look for characters, brands, and condition.
Event buyers care about quantity, fairness, and easy distribution.
Live selling audiences respond to urgency, variety, and clear rules.

sections.heading: Sort before you sell
body: Sorting is where a mixed toy haul becomes a business asset. Do not post everything at once in a messy pile. Separate the haul into useful groups: baby toys, educational toys, character toys, plush toys, vehicles, pretend play, boxed items, and premium finds.

After sorting, inspect condition and clean what needs cleaning. Set aside items that are better for bundle freebies, lower-price lots, or event giveaways. This keeps your main sale album cleaner and makes your pricing easier to explain.

A clean sorting system also helps you produce better content. You can create one album for character toys, one post for preschool learning items, one live session for surprise bundles, and one premium post for standout finds.

image.alt: Sorted Toyzoona toy stocks ready for bulk buyers and resellers
image.caption: Sorting turns a mixed haul into clear product categories buyers can understand.

sections.quote: A reseller does not just buy toys. A reseller edits a haul into choices customers can say yes to.

sections.heading: Price with weight, effort, and demand in mind
body: Your selling price should consider the cost of the haul, the time spent sorting, cleaning, photographing, packing, and responding to buyers, plus the demand for specific toy categories. A recognizable character toy in good condition should not be priced the same as a generic filler item.

Use bundles to move stock faster. Low-price bundles can clear volume, while themed bundles can increase perceived value. A parent might buy a pretend-play bundle faster than five separate loose items if the bundle feels complete.
Keep simple records from day one. Track how much you spent, what categories sold fastest, which posts got inquiries, and which items stayed unsold. Your second haul should be smarter than your first.
bullets: Use low-tier bundles for fast-moving mixed items.
Use themed bundles for giftable sets.
Use premium pricing only when condition, character, or demand supports it.
Keep unsold items visible through reposts, live selling, and bundle refreshes.

faqs.question: Can I start a toy reseller business with mixed toys?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mixed toy lots can work for beginners if the reseller sorts inventory, photographs items clearly, prices bundles realistically, and posts consistently.

faqs.question: What should I bring when buying bulk toys?
faqs.answer: Bring a phone with battery, a clear budget, reference notes for your target categories, and enough time to inspect the available stock before deciding.

faqs.question: Where should new toy resellers sell first?
faqs.answer: Many beginners start with Facebook groups, Facebook Marketplace, local community chats, live selling, short-form videos, and organized photo albums.

title: Facebook Live Toy Buying: Why Schedule, Proof, and Timing Matter
description: How Toyzoona buyers can use live schedules, countdowns, Facebook page updates, and official announcements to catch current toy availability.
summary: Facebook live toy buying works best when buyers know the schedule, follow the official page, watch current stock previews, and act during the active buying window. For Toyzoona, the site countdown and Facebook updates help buyers avoid guessing when stocks and sellers are active.
deck: Toys are visual, fast-moving products. This article explains how live selling, countdowns, and official page updates help buyers make faster and more confident decisions.

heroImage.alt: Toyzoona Importer media and live selling proof image
heroImage.caption: Live selling works because buyers can see current items, not just read a static product list.

takeaways: Live toy buying reduces uncertainty because buyers can see current stock.
The Facebook page is the fastest place to watch announcements and proof.
The countdown should guide when to expect active buying windows.
Message the official page when you need confirmation before ordering or visiting.

sections.heading: Why toys sell well on live video
body: Toys are emotional and visual. Buyers want to see color, size, condition, quantity, and variety before they decide. A live video can show those details faster than a static caption.

Live selling also creates urgency. When buyers see other customers asking, reserving, or reacting, they understand that stock can move. This matters for imported toy batches because availability can change within the same day.
For parents and resellers, live video also builds confidence. They can ask questions, compare categories, and see the scale of the current stock before committing to a haul.

image.alt: Wide Toyzoona toy stock photo used for live buying previews
image.caption: Current stock visibility is the biggest advantage of live toy buying.

sections.quote: A live selling schedule turns random checking into intentional buying.

sections.heading: Use the Facebook page as your buying dashboard
body: The Facebook page is more than a link. It is where buyers can look for announcements, buyer proof, auction notices, previews, and reminders. Following the page helps customers see what is active instead of relying on outdated posts.

A good buyer habit is to check the page before asking broad questions. Look for the newest live posts, auction schedules, and current reminders. If a post is old, confirm through the official page before assuming the stock is still available.
This is also where returning buyers can build familiarity with the buying rhythm. The more you understand how Toyzoona announces stock, the easier it becomes to plan visits or online orders.

image.alt: Toyzoona showroom stocks for buyers checking live and Facebook page updates
image.caption: Online updates and warehouse availability should be checked together.

bullets: Check newest Facebook page posts before relying on old screenshots.
Use the official page for confirmation.
Watch for auction posts if you want Saturday deals.
Join live sessions early when you are looking for specific categories.

sections.heading: How the website countdown helps
body: The Toyzoona website countdown follows Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine time. When the business is inside live hours, the countdown shifts into a live-status message so buyers know the window is active.
Outside those hours, the countdown points buyers toward the next opening window. This is useful for customers who discover Toyzoona late at night or on Sunday and need to know when to check back.
A countdown does not replace direct confirmation, but it gives buyers a clear rhythm: check the site, open the Facebook page, confirm current stock, then act during the buying window.
bullets: Use the countdown for timing.
Use Facebook for current stock proof.
Use direct messaging for final confirmation.

title: Bulk Toys for Events, Giveaways, Party Prizes, and School Rewards
description: Ideas for turning Toyzoona bulk toy hauls into organized prize bundles for birthdays, school events, raffles, classroom rewards, and family celebrations.
summary: Bulk toys can be turned into age-based bundles, raffle prizes, classroom reward boxes, birthday game prizes, and family gift packs. The best event results come from sorting by age, theme, and prize tier before distribution.
deck: A planning guide for parents, teachers, organizers, and community buyers who need many toys without making every prize feel random.

heroImage.alt: Toy fair display with colorful toys suitable for event prize planning
heroImage.caption: Event toy planning works best when toys are grouped before the event day.

takeaways: Sort bulk toys by age range before packing giveaways.
Use prize tiers so games and raffles feel more exciting.
Build flexible themes instead of depending on exact toy models.
Confirm current stock before promising a specific giveaway concept.

sections.heading: Plan by age range first
body: Event toy planning should start with the children, not the toys. A toddler prize, a preschool reward, and an older-kid raffle item should not be treated as interchangeable.

Before packing giveaways, separate baby-safe items, preschool toys, pretend-play pieces, plush toys, vehicles, learning toys, and standout character items. This helps prevent mismatched prizes and makes distribution smoother on event day.
If the event includes different ages, prepare labeled groups. Even simple labels like toddler, preschool, grade school, and premium raffle can prevent confusion.

image.alt: Toy event display with colorful toys for children and families
image.caption: Age grouping keeps giveaways organized and easier to distribute.

bullets: Toddler groups should prioritize simpler, safer items.
Preschool groups can include learning toys, pretend play, and characters.
Older children may respond better to collectibles, vehicles, or standout items.
Premium items can be reserved for raffles or grand prizes.

sections.heading: Create prize tiers instead of identical packs
body: Not every event prize needs to have the same value. In fact, mixed prize tiers can make games and raffles more exciting. Use smaller toys for participation rewards, medium bundles for game winners, and standout pieces for grand prizes.

This is where bulk buying becomes useful. One toy haul can supply different prize levels if the items are sorted intentionally. Instead of forcing identical loot bags, you can create more flexible and memorable prize sets.
For birthdays, small prize tiers work well for games. For school activities, reward boxes can be organized by behavior incentives, raffle draws, or classroom milestones.

image.alt: Colorful toy display for party prize and giveaway planning
image.caption: Prize tiers let one bulk toy haul serve several event moments.

sections.quote: A good event prize system feels organized, not random.

sections.heading: Confirm stock before building the final plan
body: Toy stocks change, so event buyers should avoid planning around one exact toy unless it has already been confirmed. A stronger plan uses flexible categories: plush toys, cars, learning toys, character toys, baby toys, or assorted prizes.

Before the event date, message the official page or check the Facebook page for current stock updates. If you need a specific quantity, say the event date, age range, budget, and preferred toy categories when asking.
The more specific your event details are, the easier it is to decide whether the current Toyzoona batch fits your plan.
bullets: Share the event date when asking about availability.
Mention the number of kids or expected prize count.
Give an age range so unsuitable toys can be avoided.
Stay flexible with themes unless a stock batch is confirmed.
